app.title: RDB RTT benchmark
hero.lead:
Measures how the round-trip time (RTT) between an application and a database
affects SQL response time, and simulates processing time.
eq.title: Response time model of an SQL statement
eq.n: Round trips between the application and the database
eq.drtt: Time added to each round trip

range.title: Measured span
range.svgDesc: Acquiring and releasing the DB connection and reading session statistics are outside the measured span. The measured span T runs from the DAO method call until the result is returned. Each fetch is one round trip: the ΔRTT wait, traffic on the forward path, database processing, and traffic on the return path.
range.tDesc: Elapsed time of one call to the data access framework
range.outsideDesc: Acquiring and releasing the DB connection, reading session statistics, and logging
range.nDesc: Difference between the database session statistic (SQL*Net round trips in V$MYSTAT) read before and after the measured span
